main.description: A bartender or drink designer's professional profile, at rkey `self`. Deliberately contains NO score and NO aggregate. A portfolio is computed by following `recipes` out to the works themselves and reading their reception — a pull the maker initiates, not a number anyone can rank them by. There is intentionally no way to express 'this person rates N'.

recipes.description: Works this person claims. Reception is read from these, never stored here.

venues.description: Where they pour or have poured.
